senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. פתח) [to be open, wide,] to be accessible to influences, be compliant.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 21:5">Ex. R. s. 21</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Hosea 7:11">Hos. VII, 11</cite>) <he>אצלי הם כיונה פוֹתָה וכ׳</he> towards me they are like a tame dove, whatever I decree over them, they do and obey, but towards the nations of the world they are intractable like wild beasts.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 38a:17">Snh. 38ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>מי פתי</he> <cite ref="Proverbs 9:16">Prov. IX, 16</cite>) <he>מי פְּתָאוֹ לזה וכ׳</he> who persuaded this man (Adam)? A woman spoke to him; (differ. in <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 943:7">Yalk. Prov. 943</cite>).—[<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:4">Num. R. s. 7</cite> <he>ופותין</he>, read: <he>ופוֹתְתִין</he>, v. <cite ref="Q02213"><he>פָּתַת</he></cite>.]

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 29">Lev. R. s. 29</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 89:16">Ps. LXXXIX, 16</cite>) <he>שהם מכירין לפַתּוֹת וכ׳</he> they know how to win the favor of their Creator &c.; (<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 81:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. 81</cite> <he>לרצות</he>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 840">Yalk. Ps. 840</cite>; Pesik. Baḥod., p. 152ᵃ. Y. Kidd. III, 64ᶜ top <he>מְפַתִּים אותו … וכופין וכ׳</he> they (the court) persuade him to give her a letter of divorce, but they force him to &c.; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 71">Gen. R. s. 71</cite> <he>פיתיתי</he>, v. infra.

senses.gloss: to gratify; to mislead by gratifying; to deceive.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 6">Lev. R. s. 6</cite>, beg. (ref. to <he>יהפתית</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 24:28">Prov. XXIV, 28</cite>) <he>מאחר שפִּתִּיתֶם אותו בסיני וכ׳</he> after you gratified him at Sinai, saying (<cite ref="Exodus 24:7">Ex. XXIV, 7</cite>) &c.
<cite ref="Exodus 24:7">Ib.</cite> <he>מאחר שפִּתִּיתָ בשפתיך וכ׳</he> after thou hast gratified with thy lips (promised to appear as witness) and caused him to go to law; a. e.—

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 7">Deut. R. s. 7</cite> (play on <he>ובמ̇ופ̇ת̇ים</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 4:34">Deut. IV, 34</cite>) <he>היו המכות מְ֗פַ֗תּ֗וֹת אותם וכ׳</he> the plagues (by coming at intervals) deceived them (made the Egyptians believe every time that they were relieved forever); Midr. Till, to <cite ref="Psalms 78:43">Ps. LXXVIII, 43</cite> <he>מפיתית בהן</he> ed. Bub. (oth. ed. <he>שפותות בהן</he>; corr. acc.).

senses.gloss: to entice. Y. Snh. X, 28ᵈ the strong Moabite wine שהוא מְפַתֶּה הגנף לזנות which opens the body to lust; Num. R. s. 10, a. e., v. פְּתוּגְתָּא; a. fr.—Esp. to seduce.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 3:9">Keth. III, 9</cite> (<cite ref="Ketubot 41a:1">41ᵃ</cite>) <he>האומר פִּיתֵּיתִי את וכ׳</he> if one declares, I have seduced that man’s daughter. Ib. 4 <he>המְפַתֶּה נותן</he> the seducer pays three fines, opp. to <cite ref="A00753"><he>אונס</he></cite>; a. fr.—Y. Keth. III, 27ᵇ <he>שהפיתתו</he>, read: <he>שהיא פִיתְּתוֹ</he> when she seduced him.
Gen. R. s. 71; Yalk. ib. 127 פּוּתֵּיתִי (not פית׳), v. יָסַת.—Part. f. מְפוּתָּה a seduced woman.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 302">Yalk. Is. 302</cite> <he>אף היא מִתְפַּתָּה … ומרחבת וכ׳</he> it (Gehenna), too, grows every day wider and broader and deeper (with ref. to <cite ref="V00864"><he>תפתה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Isaiah 30:33">Is. XXX, 33</cite>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:8">Gen. R. s. 17</cite> <he>מפני מה האיש נוח להִתְפַּתּוֹת וכ׳</he> why is man easily appeased and woman is not?; v. <cite ref="Q00602"><he>פִּיּוּס</he></cite>.—Num. R. l. c. <he>ע״י היין נִתְפַּתּוּ וזנו</he> through wine they were enticed and they committed whoredom.

<cite ref="Eruvin 19a:19">Erub. 19ᵃ</cite> (play on <cite ref="V00864"><he>תפתה</he></cite>, v. supra) <he>כל המִתְפַּתֶּה ביצרו יפול שם</he> whosoever is carried away by his evil desire falls into it (Gehenna). Yalk. Is. l. c.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 4:1">Keth. IV, 1</cite> <he>נערה שנִתְפַּתְּתָה וכ׳</he> if a young girl has been seduced (v. <cite ref="N00970"><he>נַעֲרָה</he></cite>); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to insinuate one’s self, to make one’s self popular. Esth. R. introd. (play on אפ̇ת̇ם, Ezra IV, 13) אפי׳ דברים שהמלכות מִתְפַּתָּה בהם וכ׳ even with those things by which the (Roman) government makes itself popular, as theatres and circuses, it does harm.
